popCulture.title: Theogony (Menoetius)
popCulture.creator: Hesiod
popCulture.description: Hesiod’s outrageous Titan — son of Iapetus and Clymene, brother of Atlas, Prometheus, and Epimetheus — whom Zeus blasts with a thunderbolt into Erebus. Distinct from Menoetius father of Patroclus.

popCulture.title: Menoetius (Titan)
popCulture.description: The blasted brother of Prometheus — hubris punished in the Iapetid line; not the mortal father of Patroclus who shares the name.
